user.title: Configure Gemini HA
user.description: Enter your Google Gemini API key. The integration will set up a conversation agent, a speech-to-text (STT) service, and a text-to-speech (TTS) service powered by the Gemini Live API.

data_description.api_key: Your Google Gemini API key. You can obtain one from https://aistudio.google.com/.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Gemini API. Please verify your API key and try again.

data_description.chat_model: Gemini model used for the conversation agent (e.g. gemini-2.0-flash-live-001).
data_description.stt_language: Language expected from the microphone input.
